latest_release.name: v2026.5
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore: back to snapshot after v2026.4 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2540
* chore: bump com.diffplug.spotless:spotless-maven-plugin from 3.10.1 to 3.10.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2536
* test(xxe): use deterministic entity targets by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2547
* chore: bump com.auth0:java-jwt from 4.6.0 to 4.6.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2538
* feat(cryptography): add HMAC timing attack lesson by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2548
* test(sql-injection): cover mitigation form submissions by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2549
* ci: run matrix builds in parallel by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2550
* feat(http): add parameter pollution lesson by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2546
* chore: bump alpine from 3.24.1 to 3.24.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2553
* chore: bump io.github.bonigarcia:webdrivermanager from 6.3.4 to 6.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2554
* chore: bump org.jruby:jruby from 10.1.1.0 to 10.1.2.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2555
* chore: bump org.webjars:webjars-locator-lite from 1.1.4 to 1.1.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2556
* chore: bump pre-commit-ci/lite-action from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2564
* chore: bump com.google.guava:guava from 33.7.1-jre to 33.7.2-jre by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2565
* chore: bump com.diffplug.spotless:spotless-maven-plugin from 3.10.2 to 3.10.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2566
* Add password storage lesson covering hashes, salts, and peppers by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2551
* Command injection lesson by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2257
* Fix custom port conflict in combined JAR by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2568
* Triage likely lesson vulnerability reports by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2569
* docs(cryptography): explain timing attack solutions by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2577
* feat(challenges): add chained security scenario by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2570
* fix(sql-injection): mark registration assignment solved by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2578
* fix(progress): allow users to share lesson assignments by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2580
* fix(challenges): record Challenge 8 completion by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2579
* chore(release): prepare 2026.5 by @nbaars in https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/pull/2581


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/compare/v2026.4...v2026.5
